calls.statement: SELECT tier, is_current, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT member_id) ids, min(valid_from), max(valid_from), min(valid_to), max(valid_to) FROM dim_member GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

WITH cur AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) c FROM dim_member WHERE is_current GROUP BY 1),
valid_now AS (SELECT member_id, count(*) c FROM dim_member WHERE DATE '2026-10-08' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to GROUP BY 1),
latest AS (SELECT member_id, arg_max(is_current, valid_from) cur_flag, max(valid_from) mv FROM dim_member GROUP BY 1)
SELECT
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member) all_members,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM cur) members_with_current,
 (SELECT max(c) FROM cur) max_current_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM valid_now) members_valid_on_oct8,
 (SELECT max(c) FROM valid_now) max_valid_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM latest WHERE NOT cur_flag) latest_not_current,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND valid_to <> DATE '9999-12-31') cur_but_closed,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE NOT is_current AND valid_to = DATE '9999-12-31') notcur_open,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE is_current AND tier='Gold' AND DATE '2026-10-08' BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_to) gold_valid_oct8,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM dim_member WHERE tier IS NULL OR tier NOT IN ('Basic','Silver','Gold')) odd_tier
